newsitem.title: FRANCE: UAE in talks on 18-plane Dassault order - source.
newsitem.headline: UAE in talks on 18-plane Dassault order - source.

text.p: A high-level delegation from the United Arab Emirates arrived in Paris on Wednesday for talks on a potential five-billion-franc purchase of 18 Dassault Aviation Mirage combat planes, an industry source said.
The talks, which have been going on for some time, have stuck on the price which the UAE officials believe is too high, the source said, declining to be identified.
The planes are being offered at around 300 million francs each, including missiles, the source said.
The UAE is looking to buy the Mirage 2000-9 model which has been adapted for air defence and ground strike missions.
They can carry Matra Mica and Magic air-to-air missiles as well as, eventually, the Apache cruise missile when it enters service.

The UAE has a fleet of 40 Mirage 2000 planes bought in the mid-1980s and is also looking to buy a further 80 advance combat jets. Dassault is offering its Rafale plane in competition with Lockheed Martin's F-16.
